pause_rule: Strictly calibrated <= 0.18s max pause (zero dead air)

beats.spoken_words: Notice how you never need motivation to brush your teeth at night?
beats.visual_description: Medium shot in nighttime bathroom. Protagonist in dark green hoodie stands deadpan in front of mirror holding a blue toothbrush with white foam, looking straight at viewer. Clean pen-and-ink linework on warm cream paper.

beats.spoken_words: Even when you're completely exhausted, collapsing on your bed...
beats.visual_description: Stickman collapsed face-down on edge of messy mattress in dimly lit bedroom. Heavy comic fatigue lines and exhaustion spirals float above his head.

beats.spoken_words: you still drag yourself to the sink and brush.
beats.visual_description: Side profile of protagonist mechanically shuffling in slippers back to bathroom sink, brushing with rhythmic white toothpaste foam bubbles floating.

beats.spoken_words: Why? You never asked yourself if you felt like it.
beats.visual_description: Minimalist educational blueprint card on cream paper. Bold text 'WHY?' at top. Below, a clean thought bubble containing '[ DO I FEEL LIKE IT? ]' aggressively slashed out with a thick Crimson Red X.

beats.spoken_words: That single question is why your discipline fails.
beats.visual_description: Protagonist sitting at study desk with head buried in hands, open laptop glowing blank, spiral notebook untouched, visual tension scribbles overhead.

beats.spoken_words: The second you ask, "Do I feel like working out?"
beats.visual_description: Split screen on desk: on left, pair of running gym sneakers sitting by the door; in center, a trembling thought bubble with text 'Do I feel like working out?'.

beats.spoken_words: your brain will always vote NO.
beats.visual_description: Clean off-white canvas. A giant heavy official bureaucratic rubber stamp slams down in stark Crimson Red ink: '[ VOTE: NO ]' with bold ink splatter.

beats.spoken_words: Your primitive brain hates burning energy.
beats.visual_description: 2D anatomical ink cross-section of a skull. Deep inside the brainstem, a glowing red primitive reptilian core icon labeled '[ CALORIE CONSERVATION ENGINE ]' radiates warning waves.

beats.spoken_words: It's wired to choose the warm blanket.
beats.visual_description: Protagonist wrapped like a warm cozy cocoon burrito in a fluffy duvet blanket on bed, face illuminated by soft phone glow, completely sheltered.

beats.spoken_words: Disciplined people don't have super-human willpower.
beats.visual_description: Two stickmen standing side by side: on left, an ordinary stickman imagining a mythical glowing superhero stickman with a cape crossed out with red ink.

beats.spoken_words: Studies show they actually use willpower less than you.
beats.visual_description: Side-by-side battery infographic: Left battery labeled 'DISCIPLINED PERSON' has 85% green power intact. Right battery labeled 'STRUGGLING PERSON' is drained to 5% blinking red.

beats.spoken_words: They just removed the emotional consultation.
beats.visual_description: Diagram card showing a black wire connecting [ BRAIN ] to [ ACTION ]. A pair of crisp ink scissors cleanly snips a middle wire labeled [ EMOTIONAL PERMISSION ], severing it with spark doodle.

beats.spoken_words: They treat hard work like brushing their teeth.
beats.visual_description: Clean graphic manifesto card titled '[ THE TOOTHBRUSH PROTOCOL ]' in bold architectural hand-lettering, showing an icon of a toothbrush equal to an open textbook.

beats.spoken_words: An action so automated, it never asks for permission.
beats.visual_description: Industrial minimal conveyer belt moving forward smoothly with interlocking mechanical gears, representing frictionless automatic execution without pauses.

beats.spoken_words: When the alarm rings, or the clock hits five...
beats.visual_description: Close-up of minimalist bedside digital flip clock snapping decisively to [ 5:00 AM ] or alarm bell vibrating with sharp energetic sound lines.

beats.spoken_words: you don't negotiate with your mood.
beats.visual_description: Protagonist firmly pushing away a tiny whiny cartoon stickman lawyer perched on his shoulder who is holding a briefcase labeled 'EXCUSES'.

beats.spoken_words: You put your shoes on before your feelings wake up.
beats.visual_description: Sharp kinetic close-up of protagonist hands swiftly pulling and tying black laces of white running sneakers on floor mat, ready to move.

beats.spoken_words: Action creates motivation, not the other way around.
beats.visual_description: Clean bold flow diagram in black ink and forest green accents: [ ACTION ] -> arrow -> [ MOMENTUM ] -> arrow -> [ MOTIVATION ]. A wrong reversed path is crossed out.

beats.spoken_words: Real discipline isn't fighting your feelings—
beats.visual_description: Protagonist with gym bag slung over shoulder opening front door and stepping outward calmly into crisp morning dawn, unbothered and resolute.

beats.spoken_words: it's treating your future like your teeth, and that's why...
beats.visual_description: Medium hero shot of protagonist in green hoodie standing sovereign and calm in warm sunrise glow, looking forward with quiet confidence, looping seamlessly back to Beat 1.
